topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Finding the time capsule was both a surprise and a bit unsettling. I remember the old oak tree in the backyard was a place of many secrets, but this one felt different, somehow heavier with the weight of things I couldn't quite recall. As I sifted through the contents, each item brought a flicker of recognition, a whisper of a memory, but none felt fully mine. I should be excited, sharing this discovery with the family, but I find myself hesitating, wrapping each piece back up carefully, almost reverently. It's as if I'm trying to return the items to a safe place, a place where the questions they raise can't follow me.
